name: record-navigator
title: Record navigator
description: Previous and next through a queue of records, with the position in words, keyboard shortcuts and the reason a button is off at either end.
docs: index counts from zero. Leave total out while a list is loading and the text reads "3 of many". With loop the buttons stay on at the ends and you wrap the index yourself. J and K are ignored while typing. For pages of rows use Pagination.
